status: 409
title: Approval expired
summary: |
  The request conflicts with the current state of the resource.
client_action: |
  Reload the resource, re-apply the change on top of the fresh state, and retry once.
operator_action: |
  Trace `request_id`, inspect the current resource state, and check for concurrent writers or a duplicate business key.
